description: 填写 Syspetro MCP API Key 以连接该 MCP。Key 仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传到 WorkBuddy 云端。
description_en: Enter your Syspetro MCP API Key. The key is stored locally under ~/.workbuddy and is not uploaded to the WorkBuddy cloud.
docLabel_en: How to get an API Key?

fields.description: 登录 Syspetro MCP 市场，在专用页面创建或复制 Auth Key；连接时将作为 Query 参数 authkey 注入 MCP 请求。
fields.description_en: Sign in to Syspetro MCP Marketplace and create or copy an Auth Key on the dedicated page. It is injected into MCP requests as the authkey query parameter.
fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 粘贴从 Syspetro MCP 市场获取的 API Key
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the API Key from Syspetro MCP Marketplace

title: PropMcp MCP 授权
